name: Can I paint or stain my mantel after it has been repaired?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint or stain my mantel after it has been repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in most cases, you can paint or stain your mantel after it has been professionally repaired. Our repair process often includes preparing the surface for a new finish, ensuring that any filled areas are smooth and properly integrated with the surrounding material. However, the exact timing and success of applying a new finish depend on the specific repair materials used and their curing times. We recommend discussing your finishing plans with our team during the repair consultation so we can ensure the repair process accommodates your desired aesthetic outcome, whether it's a new paint color or a fresh stain.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can typically paint or stain your mantel post-repair, especially if the surface is prepared. Discuss finishing plans during consultation for best results.
